lead: Competitive intelligence signals across the rolling year highlight active EFB, flight planning, and crew operations deployments, with suppliers such as Lufthansa Systems, Jeppesen, and IFS securing notable airline agreements.

insights.title: IFS EFB Platform Momentum
insights.finding: IFS secured multiple regional and hybrid/cargo carrier selections for its IFS EFBOne platform, including fastjet, TUS Airways, and MY FREIGHTER (Centrum Air).
insights.aviation_context: fastjet is an African low-cost carrier, while TUS Airways operates as a hybrid/leisure carrier.
insights.caveat: Captured via LinkedIn and Google News signals; real-world deployment progress varies.

insights.title: Jeppesen Introduces AI Agents for ForeFlight
insights.finding: Jeppesen rolled out initial artificial intelligence agents for its ForeFlight Airflow aviation operations platform to assist with business aviation workflows.
insights.aviation_context: Focuses on the business aviation segment within the ForeFlight product line.
insights.caveat: Feature capability currently rolling out in initial phases.

insights.title: Lufthansa Systems Expands Lido Flight 4D Deployments
insights.finding: Lufthansa Systems advanced its flight planning footprint through the implementation of Lido Flight 4D for Kenya Airways.
insights.aviation_context: Kenya Airways operates as a full-service African carrier.
insights.caveat: Signals captured via LinkedIn posting activity.
